slides.texte_overlay:
hard things to do
by yourself to become
unbreakable

eat at a restaurant alone

no phone on the table.
you'll notice everything.

hike a trail
you've never walked

no group. no guide.
just you and the next step.

train when the gym is empty

no one to impress.
only the work.

watch a sunrise alone

no photo. no story.
just be there for it.

sit with a hard decision
for a full day

don't ask five people.
trust your own head.

spend 5 minutes a day
learning on your own

no class. no teacher.
just a quiet habit.
slides.texte_sophia:
i swap my morning scroll
for 5 minutes on the Sophia app

no class. no teacher.
just a quiet habit.
